injuries.description: multiple rib fractures of different ages
source: Dr. K. L. Hau, the pathologist, had said that it was hard to perceive that a single episode of fall could have accounted for the findings of multiple bruises and scars of different ages as described in the medical reports and revealed on the photos as well as the findings of multiple rib fractures of different ages mentioned in the medical report.

injuries.description: Scars on her scalp, left upper eyelid, right medial upper eyelid, left forehead, mid nose, upper lip, left chest and left breast
injuries.body_part: scalp, face, left chest and left breast
source: Scars were left on her scalp, left upper eyelid, right medial upper eyelid, left forehead, mid nose, upper lip, left chest and left breast.

According to the report, the scars on her body were the result of injuries inflicted by objects most likely blunt in nature, the scars on her left breast were similar to scald injuries or abrasion caused by blunt objects.
